blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol, Philippines — El Niño-induced dry conditions have resulted in an estimated P173.69 million in agricultural losses in Bohol, affecting 6,676 farmers across 24 of the province’s 48 municipalities and one city, based on a partial assessment by the Office of the Provincial Agriculturist (OPA).
